core_obligations: Start from the definition (proof lines 760-765): choose an injective resolution F -> I^bullet, so that R^i f_* F is the i-th cohomology sheaf of the complex f_* I^0 -> f_* I^1 -> ...

Write that cohomology sheaf as a sheafified presheaf (proof lines 766-774): by the abelian category structure on O_D-modules it is the sheaf associated to V -> ker(f_* I^i(V) -> f_* I^{i+1}(V)) / im(f_* I^{i-1}(V) -> f_* I^i(V)).

Identify the sections of f_* with sections over u(V) (proof lines 775-780): the displayed quotient is equal to the same quotient formed from the complex I^bullet evaluated at u(V), which is H^i(u(V), F).
Conclude that R^i f_* F is the sheaf associated to V -> H^i(u(V), F) (proof lines 780-781).
proof_roadmap: Resolve F by injectives, so that R^i f_* F is a cohomology sheaf of f_* I^bullet.
Express that cohomology sheaf as the sheafification of the presheaf of kernels modulo images.
Replace sections of f_* I^j over V by sections of I^j over u(V), which turns the quotient into the i-th cohomology of I^bullet at u(V).
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the higher direct images of a module on a ringed site with the sheafification of the presheaf V -> H^i(u(V), F) (statement lines 746-757). The argument is a two-step unfolding of definitions: an injective resolution F -> I^bullet turns R^i f_* F into the i-th cohomology sheaf of f_* I^bullet (proof lines 760-765), and the cohomology sheaf of a complex of O_D-modules is the sheaf associated to the presheaf of kernels modulo images (proof lines 766-774), whose sections are then rewritten as sections of I^bullet over u(V), giving H^i(u(V), F) (proof lines 775-780). The non-formal content is the recognition that the sheafification step is what makes the naive presheaf equal to the derived pushforward. The claim is H2: two definitions unfolded in the right order, no additional construction.
